summary: An experimental generative firmware, grown from a Melodee fork, where four tracks play written steps or rule-based generators that listen to each other and evolve over time.
features: 13 generators including TURING, EUCLID, MARKOV, ATLAS and SERIES
EVOLVE, FORM and DEVELOP grow phrases into sections over time
Seeded randomness: PLAY replays a piece exactly, ROLL makes a new one
16 modulation cords and a CHORD track that keeps parts in key
FM6, ORACLE, TRIO and 808/909 DRUM sounds; MIDI and clock out over USB
Single-core build offered for units that crash on the standard one
